description: What TmAgentPlan may show and edit: the reviewable plan before a run, or the read-only plan of a run in progress. The mode is a switch of SHAPE, not only of permissions — a Review plan offers renaming, adding, removing and reordering plus the Approve / Run actions, while a Running plan renders the same rows read-only and adds the live timer, the failure and the Retry action.

members.name: Review
members.description: The plan is being reviewed; every edit path and every plan action is available.

members.name: Running
members.description: The plan is running; the rows are read-only and only a failed step still offers Retry.
